sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: BROAD CYCLONIC UPPER FLOW WILL EXTEND FROM THE NRN PLAINS EWD ACROSS THE GREAT LAKES AND INTO NEW ENGLAND OVERNIGHT...SANDWICHED BETWEEN A HUDSON BAY LOW AND UPPER HIGH OVER THE MID MS VALLEY. AT THE SURFACE...A DEFORMATION ZONE/AXIS OF CONTRACTION WILL EXTEND FROM SRN NEB EWD ACROSS CNTRL IL...WITH SUBSTANTIAL LOW LEVEL MOISTURE REMAINING IN THIS ZONE. ELSEWHERE...SUBSTANTIAL MOISTURE WILL STREAM NWD ACROSS AZ WITH AREAS OF HEAVY RAIN...AND DAYTIME HEATING WILL LEAD TO MAINLY NON-SEVERE CONVECTION OVER THE SERN STATES.

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS INTO THE MID MO VALLEY
sections.text: DAYTIME HEATING WILL LEAD TO AN UNSTABLE AIR MASS ALONG A LOW PRESSURE TROUGH EXTENDING FROM NRN WY INTO WRN KS. ELY UPSLOPE FLOW WILL MAINTAIN A FEED OF MOISTURE INTO THESE AREAS WITH AN ERUPTION OF THUNDERSTORMS BY EARLY AFTERNOON FROM SERN MT/NERN WY INTO WRN NEB AND ERN CO. SHEAR PROFILES WILL BE AIDED BY THE BACKED LOW LEVEL WINDS...AND STORMS WITH HAIL AND GUSTY OUTFLOW WINDS. SOME OF THESE STORMS MAY EVENTUALLY CONGEAL INTO ONE OR MORE MCSS EVOLVING EWD ALONG THE RETURNING WARM FRONT.

sections.title: WI/IA EWD INTO IND AND OH
sections.text: CONVECTION...SOME SEVERE WITH LARGE HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS...IS EXPECTED TO BE ONGOING ACROSS PORTIONS OF ERN IA...SRN WI...AND POSSIBLY NRN IL EARLY MON. HEATING WILL OCCUR AHEAD OF THIS ACTIVITY AS IT CONTINUES SEWD ACROSS IL...IND...AND OH DURING THE DAY. VERY STRONG INSTABILITY WILL DEVELOP AHEAD OF THE PRE FRONTAL TROUGH...AND HIGH PW CONTENT AND 30-50 KT MID LEVEL FLOW WILL ENABLE STORMS TO REGENERATE AND PRODUCE DAMAGING WINDS. ..JEWELL/GARNER.. 07/11/2011

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: DOMINANT UPR RIDGE WILL REMAIN ANCHORED OVER THE LWR MS/TN VLYS THIS PERIOD AS REMNANT VORT MAX ASSOCIATED WITH FORMER UPR LOW OVER THE CANADIAN PRAIRIES SHEARS E ACROSS CNTRL/SRN ONT...AND UPR LOW SETTLES S ALONG THE BC CST. AT THE SFC...DIFFUSE COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH ONT VORT WILL CONTINUE SE ACROSS THE UPR GRT LKS/MID MS VLY TODAY...WHILE WRN PORTION RETURNS NWD AS A WARM FRONT ACROSS CNTRL/NRN HI PLNS. AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT...MOISTURE GRADIENT MARKING LEADING EDGE OF RICH BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE WILL SURGE E/NE ACROSS THE MIDWEST INTO THE UPR OH VLY/LWR GRT LKS.

sections.title: MID MS VLY INTO OH VLY/CNTRL APPALACHIANS TODAY/TNGT
sections.text: A BAND OF ENHANCED DEEP WLY FLOW...WITH 700 MB SPEEDS OF 30-35 KTS...WILL SPREAD FROM W TO E ACROSS THE MIDWEST/OH VLY TODAY...IN TANDEM WITH JET STREAK ASSOCIATED WITH UPR VORT CROSSING SRN/CNTRL ONT. STRONG HEATING AND CONTINUED LOW LVL MOISTURE INFLOW S AND SE OF MCSS NOW OVER LWR MI AND NRN IL/SRN WI SHOULD SUPPORT SUBSTANTIAL DESTABILIZATION BENEATH THIS CORRIDOR OF ENHANCED FLOW...WITH SBCAPE LIKELY TO EXCEED 4000 J/KG BY EARLY AFTN FROM CNTRL IL E/ESE INTO MOST OF IND/OH. COMBINATION OF VERY STRONG INSTABILITY AND HIGH PW /AVERAGE VALUES AROUND 2 INCHES/ WITH 30+ KT MEAN LWR TROPOSPHERIC FLOW SHOULD SUPPORT REGENERATION/STRENGTHENING OF EXISTING STORM CLUSTERS AND...WITH TIME...ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT ON OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES FROM THE SAME...LATER TODAY INTO TNGT FROM PARTS OF IL ESE/SE ACROSS THE NRN HALF OF THE OH VLY INTO THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS. ONE OR MORE CLUSTERS COULD AFFECT THE REGION...WITH EMBEDDED BOWING SEGMENTS PRODUCING SWATHS OF DMGG WIND AND SCTD INSTANCES OF SVR HAIL.

sections.title: NRN HI PLNS INTO THE MID MO VLY LATER TODAY/TNGT
sections.text: SELY LOW LVL FLOW WILL STRENGTHEN OVER THE CNTRL AND NRN HI PLNS TODAY AS AFOREMENTIONED WARM FRONT REDEVELOPS N ACROSS REGION AND LEE TROUGH BECOME BETTER DEFINED IN WAKE OF NRN PLNS SFC HIGH. INCREASING MOISTURE AND SFC HEATING SHOULD SUFFICIENTLY BOOST SBCAPE /TO AROUND 1500 J PER KG/ TO SUPPORT SCTD AFTN/EVE STORMS INVOF LEE TROUGH FROM SE MT INTO ERN WY...FAR WRN PORTIONS OF SD/NEB...AND PERHAPS NRN CO. WIND PROFILES/LOW LVL UPSLOPE COMPONENTS SHOULD FAVOR SEWD DEVELOPMENT OF THE STORMS. BACKED LOW LVL FLOW WILL SUPPORT STORM ROTATION/SUPERCELLS WITH HAIL...LOCALLY DMGG WIND AND PERHAPS A COUPLE TORNADOES. SOME OF THIS ACTIVITY...ESPECIALLY THAT IN ERN WY...LIKELY WILL MERGE INTO ONE OR MORE MCSS THAT MOVE MAINLY ESE INTO NEB. THESE COULD EXTEND THE THREAT FOR WIND AND POSSIBLY HAIL WELL INTO THE NIGHT ACROSS THE LWR PLNS...IN INCREASINGLY MOISTURE-RICH ZONE ALONG AND JUST N OF WARM FRONT.

sections.title: ELSEWHERE
sections.text: SUBSTANTIAL MOISTURE WILL STREAM NWD ACROSS AZ...WITH ASSOCIATED AREAS OF HEAVY RAIN. DAYTIME HEATING WILL LEAD TO MAINLY NON-SVR STORMS OVER FL AND ALONG THE ERN GULF CST. ..CORFIDI/SMITH.. 07/11/2011

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER NRN MAINE
sections.text: ...LOWER GREAT LAKES/OHIO VALLEY... BOWING QLCS CONTINUES TO MOVE EWD AT 50 KT ACROSS SERN LOWER MI AND EXTREME NWRN OH...WITH THE SRN END OF THE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM TRAILING SWWD INTO NRN INDIANA. ADDITIONAL STRONG/SEVERE STORMS ARE OVER NWRN OH IN ADVANCE OF THE BOW ECHO SYSTEM. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS LIMITED CLOUDS OVER MUCH OF OH INDICATING STRONG DIABATIC HEATING/DESTABILIZATION WILL OCCUR THIS AFTERNOON...AS STEEP LAPSE RATES /REF 12Z KILX SOUNDING/ SPREAD EWD FROM THE MIDDLE MS VALLEY REGION WITHIN BAND OF MODERATE WESTERLY LOW-MID LEVEL FLOW. THE BOWING QLCS IS LIKELY TO CONTINUE EWD/ESEWD AS NEW CELLS DEVELOP ON THE SRN END. SINCE THE BOWING QLCS IS MOVING MORE RAPIDLY THAN THE DOWNSTREAM STORMS...THERE IS SOME UNCERTAINTY REGARDING THE STORM SCALE EVOLUTION AS IT OVERTAKES THE LEADING CONVECTIVE STORMS...BUT STRONG DESCENDING REAR-INFLOW JET EVIDENT IN VAD PROFILES SUGGEST SUFFICIENT WESTERLY MOMENTUM EXISTS FOR THE SYSTEM TO CONTINUE ACROSS MUCH OF OH THIS AFTERNOON. PRIMARY THREAT WILL REMAIN DAMAGING WIND GUSTS BUT LARGE HAIL MAY ALSO BE POSSIBLE GIVEN THE STEEPENING LAPSE RATES.

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS INTO MIDDLE MO VALLEY
sections.text: MOIST UPSLOPE LOW LEVEL FLOW IS BECOMING ESTABLISHED OVER THE HIGH PLAINS WITH 55-60F SURFACE DEW POINTS EVIDENT FROM SERN MT INTO ERN WY...INCREASING TO THE MID/UPPER 60S OVER NEB. CURRENT AREAS OF CLOUDS ARE LIKELY TO DIMINISH THIS AFTERNOON WITH REGIONS OF STRONGER HEATING CONTRIBUTING TO MODERATELY UNSTABLE CONDITIONS WITH MLCAPE OF 1000-2000 J/KG. STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON AND SPREAD EWD INTO THE LOW LEVEL MOISTURE/INSTABILITY AXIS OVER THE PLAINS. ALTHOUGH MID LEVEL WINDS ARE ONLY FORECAST TO BE AROUND 25-30 KT...STRONG DIRECTIONAL SHEAR WITH HEIGHT WILL ENHANCE CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION AND INTENSITY WITH A FEW SUPERCELLS POSSIBLE. STRONGER CELLS WILL BE CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS...AND A FEW TORNADOES /ESPECIALLY FROM EXTREME ERN WY/SWRN SD INTO NEB/. CONVECTION MAY GROW UPSCALE INTO AN MCS THIS EVENING AS THE LOW LEVEL JET INTENSIFIES OVER THE CENTRAL PLAINS...WITH SEVERE THREAT CONTINUING ACROSS PARTS OF NEB DURING THE OVERNIGHT HOURS.

sections.title: SWRN/SOUTH CENTRAL MT
sections.text: SWLY FLOW ALOFT IS FORECAST TO INCREASE OVER THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN AND NRN ROCKIES REGIONS IN ADVANCE OF THE UPPER LOW MOVING SSEWD OFF THE PACIFIC NW COAST. CURRENT WEAK CONVECTION OVER SWRN MT MAY SERVE TO MOISTEN THE COLUMN AND RESULT IN FURTHER DESTABILIZATION THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. MODELS SUGGEST A SEPARATE AREA OF STRONG CONVECTION WILL DEVELOP LATER THIS AFTERNOON WITHIN A ZONE OF 35-40 KT DEEP LAYER SHEAR...WHICH WILL PROMOTE A FEW SEVERE STORMS WITH LARGE HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS.

sections.title: NRN MAINE
sections.text: A STRONG SHORT WAVE TROUGH OVER ONTARIO IS FORECAST MOVE RAPIDLY EWD INTO SRN QUEBEC...AS A BAND OF STRONGER WESTERLY WINDS ALOFT SPREAD DOWNSTREAM ACROSS NRN NEW ENGLAND. 12Z CAR RAOB SHOWS MODERATELY STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE ALREADY PRESENT OVER THE AREA...AND SUFFICIENT MOISTURE WILL RESULT IN UNSTABLE CONDITIONS WITH MLCAPE OF 1000-1500 J/KG. STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP OVER PARTS OF SRN QUEBEC LATER THIS AFTERNOON AND MOVE ACROSS NRN MAINE WITH THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS. ..WEISS/LEITMAN.. 07/11/2011

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PORTIONS OF MAINE
sections.text: ...OH VALLEY AND SRN APPALACHIANS... LONG LIVED BOWED ECHO HAS TURNED SEWD IN RESPONSE TO NEW STORMS DEVELOPING ON THE WRN FLANK OF LINEAR SYSTEM. WHILE THE LINE CONTINUES TO INTERCEPT A VERY WARM AND EXTREMELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS FEEDING IN FROM THE WEST...THE LINE IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE MOVING MOSTLY SWD DUE TO THE STRONG WLY PROPAGATIONAL VECTOR. GIVEN THE STRONG INSTABILITY AND ORGANIZED COLD POOL...WIND DAMAGE IS LIKELY WITH THE SYSTEM THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THE AFTERNOON AND INTO THE EVENING HOURS. HOWEVER...GIVEN THE MEAN FLOW PARALLEL TO THE LINE AND ALSO STORMS MOVING INTO WEAKER FLOW ALOFT...THE WIND DAMAGE IS NOT EXPECTED TO BE AS EXTENSIVE AS EARLIER IN THE DAY...WITH 40 TO 60 MPH WINDS MOST COMMON. HAIL IS ALSO POSSIBLE...ESPECIALLY WITH NEWLY DEVELOPING STORMS ON THE WRN FLANK OF LINE.

sections.title: WRN TX/OK INTO WRN KS
sections.text: WV IMAGERY SHOWS THE UPPER LEVEL CIRCULATION WAS LOCATED IN THE TX PANHANDLE AND SOME OPERATIONAL AND STORM SCALE MODELS SUGGEST STORMS WILL DEVELOP DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS TO THE EAST OF THE LOW. WHILE THE SLY DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS ONLY 15-20 KT...MODERATE INSTABILITY AND 40 DEGREE TEMPERATURE/DEWPOINT SPREADS APPEAR FAVORABLE FOR STRONG AND POSSIBLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS. LOW SEVERE WIND PROBABILITIES HAVE BEEN ADDED TO THIS AREA.

sections.title: MID MS VALLEY
sections.text: SOME OF AREA HAS BEEN TRIMMED OUT OF SEVERE SINCE IT APPEARS THE REGION WILL BE LOCATED BETWEEN STORM SYSTEMS TO THE WEST AND EAST. HOWEVER...SOME HIGH RESOLUTION MODELS DO DEVELOP ISOLATED STORMS...SO DID NOT REMOVE ENTIRE RISK AREA. REST OF FORECAST ON TRACK WITH ONLY MINOR ADJUSTMENTS TO THUNDER AND SEVERE THREAT TO ACCOUNT FOR RECENT TRENDS. ..IMY.. 07/11/2011 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1126 AM CDT MON JUL 11 2011/
